programs.name: BEZ GPAD
programs.description: G-code notepad with a “spell checker” for Fanuc mill and lathe code: errors underline red, warnings yellow, with one-click fixes. Insert a safe start block with one click.

programs.name: CHIPLOAD
programs.description: Machinist calculator: speeds and feeds, tap drills, threads, bolt circles and more, with a “How was this figured?” breakdown on every result. Works offline.

programs.name: BEZ CAM
programs.description: Beginner-friendly CAM: a SolidWorks-style FreeCAD setup that turns a part into Fanuc G-code. Mill only for now.

programs.name: BEZ MaPPer
programs.description: Manufacturing process planner for machined parts. A step-by-step wizard asks about the part (shape, size, material, features, machines) and builds the process plan, with setup sheets and inspection plans you can print.
programs.note: Reading drawings is optional and uses your own Anthropic API key.

programs.name: G-Code Trainer
programs.description: Learn G-code from zero for Fanuc mills and lathes: 33 mill and 26 lathe lessons with quizzes and coding challenges, part-print challenges, 2D/3D simulators and control-panel simulators.

programs.name: LearnLinux+
programs.description: Learn Linux from zero in a simulated shell that never touches your real PC: 62 lessons, 185 quiz questions and a scored practice exam, built around the CompTIA Linux+ XK0-005 objectives.

programs.name: HackPath
programs.description: Learn ethical hacking from zero: 29 lessons over 7 tracks, aligned to CompTIA PenTest+. Practice targets run in sealed local Docker containers with no internet access.
programs.note: Needs Docker Desktop. The first run needs internet to download the practice containers.

programs.name: I Blame The Wind
programs.description: Turn-based, Worms-style artillery game: destructible terrain, wind that bends every shot, 11 weapons and pixel-art scenery. Two players on one screen, gamepad supported.

programs.name: Nowhere to Hide
programs.description: Single-player extraction FPS on a tiny spherical planet, where the curve of the horizon tells you how far away an enemy is. Grab loot and reach the beacon before the hunters close in. Gamepad supported.

programs.name: Till the Moon Bleeds
programs.description: Open-world voxel survival: mine and build on fully destructible terrain, craft, fight off zombies, and survive a blood-moon horde every 7th night. Gamepad supported.

programs.name: Deadzone Arcade
programs.description: Top-down, wave-based zombie horde shooter: five round types, a points shop and stacking perks. Gamepad supported.

programs.name: Music KID
programs.description: Scans a song and tells you its key, tempo and chords. Includes a play-along chord chart with guitar and piano shapes, batch scanning of folders, and fully offline operation.

programs.name: NoBull Music Player (Android)
programs.description: A no-nonsense local music player for Android, built to handle a tagged music library and your own untagged bounces side by side.

programs.name: NoBull Music Player (Desktop)
programs.description: The same no-nonsense player for Windows. Plays MP3, FLAC, M4A, WMA, OGG, WAV and AIFF from your own folders, with playlists and media keys.

programs.name: ANSA
programs.description: Serum-style wavetable synth built on Vital: arpeggiator, granular and multisample oscillators, two effect buses, 8 macros and 10 LFOs. VST3 plugin or standalone.

programs.name: HONE
programs.description: Audio mastering app inspired by iZotope: Assist to a target loudness, Match EQ against reference tracks, album mode, clipper, EQ and limiter, with MP3 export.

programs.name: JIG
programs.description: Tightens up a song's beat timing: finds the beats and stretches the mix (or its stems) onto a steady grid, with a before/after tightness score and WAV export.

programs.name: DIG
programs.description: Sample librarian for music producers: scans your sample folders for type, BPM and key, auditions instantly, and drags straight into your DAW. Duplicates go to a quarantine folder, never deleted.

programs.name: LIGHTBOX
programs.description: Simple drawing app for frame-by-frame cartoons, with onion skin, layers, a timeline, an audio track and lip-sync.

programs.name: ZoomDraw
programs.description: Infinite-zoom drawing: strokes stay sharp at any depth. Loop mode turns your drawing into an endless tunnel you can export as a GIF.

programs.name: Fractal Gen
programs.description: Living recursive kaleidoscope. Scroll to travel through it, and save what you like. Fully offline, with a flash limiter on by default.

programs.name: BEZ Planet Gen
programs.description: Generate a planet, walk around on it, and export it as a game asset: meshes, a Godot scene and a heightmap.

programs.name: BEZ Planet Maze
programs.description: A maze wrapped around a planet. Walk it in first person or export it as a game asset.

programs.name: The Judge
programs.description: Fly through your 3D game assets, fully rendered, and sort each one by art style (Realistic, Low-poly, Voxel, Retro/PS1 and more). Verdicts save to CSV and JSON as you go.

programs.name: BEZ Launch
programs.description: Windows 11-style dark launcher for Android, built for the Galaxy Note 8 and S Pen.

programs.name: AI Workbench
programs.description: Scripts and docs for a fully local AI tool suite (coding, images, 3D, music, speech), with a Quick Launch app that runs one GPU tool at a time.
programs.note: Scripts and docs only. Install the AI apps and models yourself.

programs.name: revu
programs.description: Claude Code skill: reviews the document you just wrote and fixes its defects.
programs.note: Unzip into your Claude Code skills folder.

programs.name: game-studio
programs.description: Claude Code skill: a full studio simulation that takes a one-line idea to a shippable game.
programs.note: Unzip into your Claude Code skills folder.
